sources.researchNote: The notice identifies Gaston Groener as a lyricist (parolier), gives his death date as 14 September 1962, records “Gol-Gauty” as a pseudonym among the rejected forms, and cites Le bistrot du port (1935) as its source.

personNameVariants.publicNote: GEMA registers the lyrics of Le bistrot du port under Stanislaus Goldhamer in one version of work no. 577359 and under Gaston Groener in the other, with the same co-authors; the Walter Jurmann works catalogue gives “Gaston Groener (St. Goldhammer)”. The sources do not say which of the two is the civil name.
Recorded by the Bibliothèque nationale de France as a pseudonym of Gaston Groener.
